queries.customers: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k) ORDER BY CustomerID
queries.transactions_1k: SELECT * FROM transactions_1k ORDER BY TransactionID

original_create_table_sql.customers:
CREATE TABLE customers
(
    CustomerID INTEGER UNIQUE     not null
        primary key,
    Segment    TEXT null,
    Currency   TEXT null
)
original_create_table_sql.transactions_1k:
CREATE TABLE "transactions_1k"
(
    TransactionID INTEGER
        primary key autoincrement,
    Date          DATE,
    Time          TEXT,
    CustomerID    INTEGER,
    CardID        INTEGER,
    GasStationID  INTEGER,
    ProductID     INTEGER,
    Amount        INTEGER,
    Price         REAL
)

projection.internal_table: sqlite_sequence is required by the unchanged AUTOINCREMENT declaration

queries.candidate:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';
queries.old_reference: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'
queries.new_reference: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT IIF(T2.Currency = 'EUR', T1.CustomerID, NULL)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'
